scope_definition: Complete with respect to standards, specifications, frameworks and registries explicitly named in the architecture/MRD/predecessor corpus plus architecture-critical standards identified during 2026-10-24 authoritative-source verification. This is not a claim of completeness of every standard worldwide.
normative_text_note: Metadata/provenance only. No copyrighted standards text is included. Authority source must be consulted for normative requirements.

provenance_policy.existing_grok_entries: Retained and not duplicated. Where an official authority URL was added, it is recorded as official_source_url; original internal provenance is preserved.
provenance_policy.new_records: Authoritative URL and access date recorded.
